notes:
Captions
- Much better word timing: captions now split at real pauses instead of grouping words seconds apart.
- New caption editor: drag a caption's edges or middle to retime it, and drag between words to time each word's animation.
- Manually added captions now animate word by word.
- Right-click a caption to split, merge or delete it.
- Install and remove caption models in Settings → Captions; nothing downloads until you choose a model.
- Seven new free caption fonts, a nicer fonts section, and "Edit as new style".

Editor and library
- Rename clips by clicking the title. Emoji and long titles now work everywhere, including file names.
- "Export & save" button on the export page to save a file without posting.
- Tidier Edits cards and styled hover hints across the app.
- The license check-in banner can be dismissed.
